extracted.intended_audience: registrants/issuer management, investor relations teams, and counsel preparing for or after an IPO
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for public-company registrants on complying with SEC Regulation FD when disclosing material nonpublic information, including timing, manner of disclosure, and preventive steps to avoid selective or unintentional disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full and fair disclosure of material nonpublic information
rubrics_metrics.description: SEC Regulation FD requires that material nonpublic information be fully and fairly disclosed to all investors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure that any information that is material and not public is disclosed in a manner that reaches the investing public generally rather than selectively to analysts, money managers, activist investors, or other investors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous public disclosure for intentional selective disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: If a registrant selectively discloses material information to persons or entities such as securities analysts, money managers, activist investors, or other investors, the company must also disclose the information publicly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the company intentionally discloses the material nonpublic information, it should make such information public at the same time as it provides the selective disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prompt public disclosure for unintentional selective disclosures (timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the company unintentionally discloses the information, it should provide such disclosure as soon as reasonably possible (i.e., within 24 hours or the start of the next day’s trading on a stock exchange such as the New York Stock Exchange, whichever comes later).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt internal procedures to identify and assess unintentional disclosures quickly so public disclosure can be made within the specified timeframe (24 hours or next trading day start, whichever is later).

rubrics_metrics.name: Broad distribution methods for public disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Such disclosures should be provided broadly to the public (e.g., in a Form 8-K or, in certain circumstances, on the registrant’s Web site).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use established, broad-reaching channels (Form 8-K filings, press releases, company website postings where appropriate) so that disclosure reaches the market generally; consider the circumstances to determine the appropriate channel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preventive controls: management education and disclosure policies
rubrics_metrics.description: To foster compliance with Regulation FD and to prevent unintentional disclosures of material nonpublic information, registrants should consider educating management on Regulation FD and should establish strong investor relations and social media policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement training for management and spokespeople, and adopt clear investor-relations and social-media policies and procedures to reduce the risk of selective or inadvertent disclosure.
